name: Poland
dek: Warszawa-Okęcie, WMO 12375. The capital's airport station, not the whole country.
paragraphs: The reference station is Warszawa-Okęcie, WMO 12375, height 106 m. The Polish submission has more than fifty station files. They were not averaged. Kraków has its own sheet with its own station.

The highest average high in the table is 25.2 °C, in July. The lowest average low is -4.0 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is July, at 82.2 mm, and the driest is March, at 29.0 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Warszawa-Okęcie, WMO 12375. Not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and E, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Poland at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 16(1) of the Road Traffic Act (Prawo o ruchu drogowym), in the consolidated text Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1251 from the Sejm legal-acts service, says right-hand traffic applies to drivers ("Kierującego pojazdem obowiązuje ruch prawostronny"). Amendments after that consolidated text were not checked for this line.
driving.sourceTitle: Prawo o ruchu drogowym, art. 16 ust. 1, Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1251 (Sejm ELI)

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.detail: The Polish Tourism Organisation's Herway Poland travel-tips page says tipping about 10% in restaurants is appreciated but not expected.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Poland, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Zloty and the code PLN for Poland.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Poland one row, Europe/Warsaw. There is no second zone for the country in either file.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Poland
entry.note: The foreign ministry's visas page. We do not restate a visa rule.
